column1: Mimicking

Our only conclusion is that we're getting there, America, because the American people have put us in a position where now we're winning. We're winning all over the place. We're winning with the tests, we're winning with the equipment, and we're winning on the vaccine. So we're winning big. And very soon, we're going to have the greatest economy in the history of our country. We will.

But as the President suggested, when we unveil the guidelines that the team has been working on, we're very close to the end of that process. And at the same time, we're working with all of the states, working very closely. We've had great dialogue with the governors, and we're in constant communication. We want to ensure that we have the best guidance, a very detailed, scientifically driven plan. But we're going to be opening up our country. We're doing that right now, and it's very exciting.

So--no, we were always going to get it. We never had a problem with it. And we're doing a fantastic job. With the equipment, we're doing a fantastic job. We're doing more than anybody else, by far. We have the best people, the smartest people, and we're very proud of them. They're working very hard. We're doing a fantastic job.

All I'm saying is this: How do you close down the greatest economy in the world? I didn't do that, frankly. We did the right thing. We did something that was a very, very tough decision. It was a horrible decision. But think of it: We saved millions of lives. Millions of lives. Nobody was going to do that. And it was very tough.

When we think of more than 619,000 Americans having tested positive, more than 45,000 having died, and perhaps, even worse, very sadly thousands more to come, we can say that this is a very bad situation. We are doing our best, and we are doing a fantastic job. We have states, and we have them now very well supplied. We have a fantastic supply chain. We're working very well with the states.

The next second time that I went with Dr. Birx in--to the President and said, "Please close down, get it done." And it was a very short period of time where he did it. He closed it down. And then when he closed it down, everyone was doing well. Not a lot of people were dying. And then he opened it up too soon, and that was a very big mistake. And so, you can say what you want, he was right to close it down. He was right to open it up too.

And after that, I said, "Oh, make sure that's in the bill." It was amazing because it wasn't in the bill. And they said, "Oh, we'll do it." And they did it. The job is going to be finished at a level nobody's ever seen before. And it will be done much quicker than we thought. I think you're going to be very happy.

But the big thing, never quit, never give up; do something you love. When you do something you love, and then all of a sudden you become happy because that's what you want to do. And that gives you great strength, and it gives you great resolve. And we have so many things happening, as you know, we're doing things that are incredible. Really incredible. And nobody thought it was even possible.

If you're Democrat, you have automatic protection. That's years and years of people putting in tremendous work, and you're protected beyond belief. We're the opposite. They're after us, and they're not after us for just a little bit. They're after us viciously. But we'll win, and we will do very well. It will be an exciting period of time. Then we have the taxes, which everybody can see and they're so low.

In the last three years, ICE has arrested over 5,000 wicked human traffickers. And I think that's a great thing. We have really done a job, a fantastic job. We’re also taking care of the most vulnerable people in our country, and always will. We will stand with them, and we will stand with them strong. We've done a fantastic job, and it's been really something to watch the great men and women that are doing these things.

We've removed unnecessary restraints on our warfighters in Afghanistan. Those who risk their life and die defending our nation, they also have to be able to fight and we're allowing them to do that. We're going to continue to do that, and you'll be seeing it now and over the many months. It's a big thing. It's a very big thing. We're also bringing our great soldiers back home.

We have a chance now to pass into law the immigration reforms that the American people have been asking for. We will have tremendous immigration reform. It's going to be very strong, and with the wall, everything's going to be fantastic. We're going to build the wall, and Mexico is going to pay for the wall, as you know. They're going to pay for the wall, and it's going to be a great wall. It's going to be a strong wall.

And I've been able to talk to many of those states. And I just remind all of us, when I talked to each one of these state health officials, where they are finding outbreaks are in nursing homes, and we're going to continue to do that. We've done a great job, just a fantastic job, on ventilators. We've done a great job, and we'll continue to work with them and give them whatever it is they need.

From the instant I took office, I moved rapidly to revive the U. S. economy--slashing taxes, cutting job-killing regulations, and unleashing America's energy resources. And you see what's happening with energy today--tremendous things. We're now the number one energy producer in the world, and that's a great honor. We've added over 7 million jobs since taking office, and the stock market is at an all-time high--a record.

You know, the truth is that we have coronavirus cases now in 46 American states. And the number of cases fluctuates, but it's, like, a big number, and the deaths are starting to go down. We are doing tremendous work. We're also, you know, we're doing testing like nobody's ever done before. We're testing at levels nobody -- you know, nobody. I mean, just think of it. I think even the press will admit that.

I want to speak now directly to America's children, especially those who feel lost, alone, confused, or even scared. I want you to know that you are loved and we will get through this together. We're going to get through this together. This is what we're doing. And you're doing really well. Incredible. The children are doing fantastically. And we are bringing back your jobs, okay? We are bringing back your jobs at a level that nobody thought possible.

The last two lines are aerosols. What does it do in the air? We have We're working on that. We have the greatest experts in the world working on it. And they're studying it. And -- and they're studying it very carefully. We're going to get the answers. And we're going to have those answers, I think, in the not-too-distant future.

These encouraging developments have put us in a very strong position to finalize guidelines for reopening the country. Whether it's a Democrat-run state or a Republican-run state, will be working with. I think with our governors, we have a great relationship. We've developed a very good relationship. And if you look at the numbers, they're fantastic, they're really good. And we will be reopening. We're going to be very, very strongly reopening.

Very importantly, we entered into historic cooperation agreements with the governments of Mexico, Honduras, El Salvador, and Guatemala. We are working very strongly with them. And they're working with us. And the relationships are fantastic. We have never had relationships like these. And they understand what's going on. We want them to do a lot more. Mexico's helping us with the wall, you know? And they're helping us in so many ways. They're doing things that nobody believed they would be doing.

That's page 1,689; page 1,762. Think of it: 1,762. And that's nowhere near the end , by the way. We’re going to be working very hard. I'm very proud of the job they're doing. And we're getting closer and closer to the vaccine. And now we have--we have some tremendous things happening. We're going be seeing, and you're going to be watching it closely, I think, very soon, a lot of great things.

But does anybody really believe the numbers of some of these countries that you've been hearing about? I don't think so. I don't think so. Look, these are bad countries. I mean, some of them are doing bad things. Some of them are not--I don't believe their numbers at all. We'll see what happens. We'll see. But the numbers have been, frankly, very bad.

And you'll see some data when Admiral Polowczyk gets up in just a few moments, but we're testing at levels that nobody's ever seen before. You see all the numbers, and they’re great numbers, and frankly, we're very proud of those numbers. We're doing tremendous testing, the best in the world, and we're doing it very, very rapidly.

To the citizens of our country, serving as your president has been the honor of my life. We have been through so much together, and we are making tremendous strides. We've seen things happen that nobody thought possible. And it's just the beginning. The best is yet to come, folks. We are winning, winning, winning.

And, as you know, Europe was just designated as the hotspot right now, and we have been working very, very closely with Europe. We're very disappointed. But we've been working very closely. And we'll see what happens, but we're working very closely. The European Union is a very good partner. They're great people, and we're working with them. And we have a lot of tremendous cooperation. I have a tremendous relationship.

A small number of social media platforms are acquiring immense power over what we can and cannot say. And you know that better than anybody. They're not letting us get our word out, and this is not going to be tolerated, okay? They're censoring and discriminating against views and people, and that's just not fair. We're going to be taking care of that, one way or the other. It's a very big problem.

But, for now, the best advice that we can give for people is to speak with their doctor, and make sure you know what's going on, and don't be afraid to ask questions. You have to ask questions. And we’re going to take care of it. We're taking care of it. We're doing a fantastic job. And we're going to get the economy back, and it's going to be very, very fast. And it's going to be a great time. Believe me.

As long as you remain loyal, faithful, and true, then our enemies don't even stand a chance. We have the greatest military in the world, and nobody can even compete with it. And, frankly, we're making tremendous progress. We're way ahead of schedule. We are going to win -- we're going to win so big. We're putting our people first. We will always put America first. And we’re going to be doing things that nobody else has been able to do. We're doing things nobody thought, frankly, that we could do.

The NIH, CDC, and FDA are also currently validating several antibody tests that will allow us to monitor the spread of the virus as we begin the next phase. We're also working very hard with states to make sure they have enough supplies, including the masks and the gowns and the face shields. We have a lot of supply. Nobody has ever had the kind of supply we have.

Good afternoon everybody. My name is Bill Bryan and I lead the Science and Technology Directorate at DHS. And I'm here today to present an update on the work that we've been doing to study the virus, what our scientists are seeing and what we're learning. We're learning a tremendous amount, and we'll continue to do that. A lot of great things are happening. We have studies going on right now, and we'll continue those studies.

No, they say worse; they say negative. They say negative. They're going to make the economy, they're going to announce the economy; I think it's going to be a very good economy. We have a very strong economy, and it's going to be very good, and we're going to be doing things. We're doing things that nobody thought was possible. We have a tremendous economy. It's a very good economy. We have a strong economy.

Likewise, we are restoring our nation's manufacturing might, even though predictions were, as you all know, were very bad from other people. We're making things again that we haven't made in decades. We're bringing jobs back. We're doing a levels that nobody thought was possible. And that includes our military, which has been totally rebuilt.

At the same time, we know that mortality and the fatalities that we're facing across the world and in our country are very, very high. We also know that, and I want everybody to understand this--we really do--that the recoveries are also very high. With the kind of numbers we've seen, it's very--it's really been something. We've made a lot of great moves. This is a war. This is a war.

So when I got $700 billion, and then $716 billion -- and this year, it's going to be $738 billion -- it's the largest number in history. We have the best military in the world, not even close. And it's doing very, very well, despite all of the politics. Whether it's right or wrong, but we are doing very, very well. We don't want to get involved, but you have to be ready. And we are ready. We are ready like never before.

Today, I am proudly announcing six brand-new initiatives to propel this new era of American Greatness. We are building the most powerful economy ever, and we are doing it fast. We're bringing back jobs and businesses. We're bringing back manufacturers. We're helping people. We're putting America first, and we're doing it now. We're winning, and we're winning big. Believe me.

And what you're seeing now with this order is that we're going to be able to produce massive amounts of testing. We’re doing more testing than any country in the world by far, and we've been working with governors, Democrats and Republicans. We’re working very well with the governors. We're constantly coordinating. And we are doing a great job, I have to say. And we’re --we’re doing a really good job, and it’s --I think it’s very important to remember that.

The ongoing tragedy in Syria is heartbreaking. Our shared goals must be the de-escalation of violence, the defeat of ISIS, and the stabilization of the region. We're working very hard with many different people we wouldn't have worked with a year ago, frankly. It's a work in progress, but we're making progress, and it's a very complex situation. It's a tough situation. We're doing a great job. Very powerful people. We're doing a really, really great job. Believe me.

Together with millions of hardworking patriots across this land, we built the greatest political movement in the history of our country. And we're going to be here for a long time, too, because we're going to make America great again. We have done things, you know, incredible things. We've done a phenomenal job. It’s been a tremendous success in so many ways.

It's been a horrible time to see such death and destruction, especially when you come --you see--just the total unnecessary tragedy that we'd been suffering. I've been very involved, and we're working very hard. We're going to get this done. We're going to get things back to where they were, and even better. We're doing things that frankly, nobody thought possible, believe me.

It was that same yearning for freedom that nearly 250 years ago gave birth to this incredible nation. This experiment, this bold undertaking, that's what America is. And now we're winning again. We're winning big. We've got a great country, and we're going to make it greater than ever before. We're going to take care of our people, and we're going to do it very, very quickly.

Through four long years, you have honed your skills, trained your mind and body, overcome and learned to lead. Now, as we consider the future, we’ll bring back our jobs. We will bring back your great companies. We will bring back our wealth. We're going to have tremendous things happen, and we are going to be opening up our country. It’s going to be a beautiful sight to see.

I was in Vietnam, and the Prime Minister and the President of Vietnam were there. And they came up to me, and they both said, "Sir, you've done more for Vietnam than any other American President." And I said, "That's nice," and I'm very honored to hear that. We're doing a great job, okay? And a lot of that goes with talent.

So I can only tell you what I know and what my recommendations were. But, we’ve done a fantastic job, whether it's with the vaccines, whether it’s with the ventilators, and the masks, as you know. We've built the greatest economy in the history of the world, and we're going to do it again. We're going to do it again very fast. We're getting ready to do it again. Because we have so much potential.

Jobs and companies are coming back to our country like never before. The power of our economy is incredible, and frankly, we were on the wrong track. We were being ripped off by everybody. But now we're winning again, and we're winning big. They respect us now, and they see what's happening. We are seeing a tremendous turnaround. We're making great progress.

And I don't think--I don't know who gave the orders to stop in Vietnam. But they were very bad orders, okay? Very, very bad. Because we had them, and then we didn't have them. And if you would have gone back to Vietnam, we would have won -- we would have won very easily. And we let it happen. And it was very, very sad.

Interestingly, we were just talking, I was talking to Doug, and the numbers they're doing are incredible. The numbers, the job numbers are, it's like a rocket ship. It's higher than it's ever been before. And we're in the process of doing things that are, frankly, unbelievable. Believe me, you're going to be so happy. You look around, and you see what's happening, and it's something that we're all very proud of.

But let me just tell you--wait. And what they're doing, because they think it is But what they're doing is this--they're finding that the--they're doing great things. And many countries, you know, they don't want to--they don't want to make it. But we have some of the greatest companies. We are going to be there. Very soon, you will see great things. We will never forget, we will never give up.

I want to thank Deborah Birx, and I want to ask her maybe to come up here. She's been working very, very hard. And she's been with us from the beginning, pretty much, and a lot of people don't know that. So, Deborah, please come up.
Last year, 70,000 Americans were killed, at least -- I think the number is ridiculously —

A safe and phased reopening of our economy--it's very exciting, but it does not mean that we're letting down our guard at all. We must remain vigilant. Believe me, we're going to be very vigilant. We want to protect the health of our citizens. We have to protect the health of our citizens. To stop the virus and protect our people, that's always been the top priority. It is going to continue to be the top priority.

Evelyn, Elizabeth, Freddy, and Robert: Tonight, everyone in this chamber is praying for you. Everyone in this chamber and all over our country. We will never forget the faces. We will never forget the pain. We will never forget the loss. And we will never, ever give up. I want to thank all of the tremendous people that work so hard to make sure that tragedies like this don’t happen. We are here to support. We are here to stay. And we are here to make sure that they have the best medical care anywhere in the world.

I have to say that, very excitingly, we're going to have somebody up; Bill will be here in a matter of moments. He just landed. And we've done a fantastic job. We've done--I have to tell you, we've done a better job than anybody. And if you look at the numbers, and you look at what we've done--what we've been able to accomplish, it's really incredible. It's really incredible.

She saw it very early on, and we have -- I don't know if we --I don't know if we would have ever had a vaccine, frankly, if those decisions weren't made early on. And some people thought we were being too early. We were--we had all the smart people. We have the best, the smartest, the greatest. And they all knew it was happening.

With every action, my administration is restoring the rule of law and reasserting the culture of freedom. We have seen the beginnings of a return to law and order. And we will not rest until all Americans are safe and secure. We're winning on trade, we're winning on jobs, and we're winning against the virus.

But a tremendous thing was done over the last number of months, but really, if you think about it, over the last five months, a tremendous job has been done with ventilators. The number of ventilators we had when we came in was very low, and now, it's a whole different story. We have more than anybody could have ever conceived. We were able to get them, and we're very proud of it.

Well, I don't know that I had exposure, but I don't have any of the symptoms. And so we'll see what happens. But you know, it's a very interesting situation. We have a lot of people that--they don't have any symptoms and, you know, they're finding this. And we're going to be looking at that very strongly, very carefully.

The Iranian government masks a corrupt dictatorship behind the false guise of a democracy. It also persecutes many minorities, and they hate the world. We’re trying to get them not to hate the world, but it’s not so easy. We will see what happens with Iran. We'll see what happens. Because they can't be in the situation they're in when they're building nuclear weapons.

I'm the one that find them. I'm the one that settled it. Over a billion dollars. You know, nobody would have ever settled that. Nobody. And we settled it. And we have a lot of them. We have so many of them. And we're doing a great job, and we're winning a lot. Many, many cases, many billions of dollars are being paid to us in the United States. And this is what's happening.

The core rights and values America defends today were inscribed in America's founding documents. Our system of government rests on the rule of law. A law that protects citizens from the abusive exercise of power is key. We're making sure people are safe. We're making sure we have the best equipment, the best medical, the greatest doctors anywhere in the world. That's what we're doing. We're doing a great job. Things are happening. And we will continue to do a great job.

We'll continue our historic regulatory reduction campaign. We've--as you know, in three and a half years, we've cut more regulations than any administration in the history of our country, and we're continuing to do it. We want to make sure we have great regulations, but the regulations are out of control. And they were totally out of control. I think we've done a fantastic job, and the states have done a fantastic job.

Iain has always dreamed of going to space. He was the first in his class to build a model rocket, complete with a small parachute. Now, here he is. He is going to be the first person to go to Mars, and he's going to do it very, very soon, and he's going to do it with very, very little money. It's gonna be a great voyage, and it's going to be a beautiful thing to watch, believe me.

As just one example, I recently met the CEO of a terrific American company, Micron They're going to be building and/or expanding plants in the United States. And they've been waiting for a long time, because for many years, they couldn't get the approvals, and now they're getting approvals. And it's all good. It's really good. We have --we worked very hard on that.

But this is an unprecedented time. But I have to tell you: When you look at the job we've done, from day one, we've done an incredible job. It's a great thing what's happened. We're working very hard. The states are working very hard. And we have incredible people in the White House, working very hard. And we're doing a fantastic job when you look at what we've done.

But I took this action early. And so the story in the New York Times --that's a different story. The story in the New York Times, you read it, it was a disaster. But you read the story in certain other places, and it's not so bad. And the fact is, we took action early, and we saved a lot of lives. And we're going to continue to save a lot of lives.

Thank you very much. So I asked Bill a question that probably some of you would like to hear the answer to, relative to the ventilators. We've got them--we've got them all. We did a tremendous job with ventilators. And we've sent them out to so many states. And we have plenty left over. And we have, as you know, we have tremendous capacity. We have so much capacity.

We see it in sons and daughters who cheer on moms and dads as they go off to work, knowing they are heroes, and in workers who show up every day, no matter what, to provide for their families and build our country. We're going to be doing things that are going to be, frankly, amazing from a standpoint of manufacturing. We're seeing those numbers go up.

So we called some people, wished them a very happy Labor Day, and they told me they're seeing tremendous results with the vaccines. Tremendous results! We're going to get this thing done, and it's going to be done very, very quickly. We're working very, very hard. And the numbers are looking great, very very strong. I have to say, very strong.

In Philadelphia, observers have been kept far away -- very far away -- so far that you wouldn't believe it. They can't get near the counting. They don't want to have anybody watch them count the votes. And they're very, very, very good at what they do--at least, that's what they think. But, we'll see what happens. We'll see.

In just over 2 years since the election, we have launched an unprecedented economic boom--a boom the likes of which we have never seen before. We've created over 6 million new jobs. The stock market is at an all-time high. And we still have a ways to go, believe me. We're doing things that nobody thought were possible. It's really something, and it's a beautiful thing. We're going to bring it bigger and better than ever before.

The American people will be encouraged to know that, as we stand here today, 24 million tests have now been administered in the United States. It’s great. And we’re doing a phenomenal job on testing. We’re doing more than anybody else. And we’re doing it very, very well. And we have many, many people that we want to test and we test very quickly.

As part of our efforts, we're leveraging the unique capabilities of S&T's National Biodefense Analysis & Countermeasures Center (NBAC), which is the only high-containment laboratory in the U.S. government dedicated to analyzing biological threats. We're doing things that are incredible. We are doing things that nobody thought possible. We're also working very strongly with the pharmaceutical companies, and they are making tremendous progress. They are making unbelievable progress.

When our nation was hit with the terrible pandemic, we produced not one, but two companies that made it, and they did a fantastic job. And these companies were incredible, and they delivered. One company, which is a--a tremendous company, a tremendous company, it’s a great company. They’re now making the vaccine, and we expect to have it very, very soon. And it'll be incredible.

You know, the President always says--the President always says we're at a turning-point moment as We are facing some very big decisions. And we're making them right now. You look at what's happening, and it's incredible. We have things happening that nobody thought possible. And we're doing it, and we're keeping Americans safe. We're going to continue to keep America safe.

Our military will soon be the strongest it has ever been. For more than 70 years, the United States has been the world's superpower, and we will remain that superpower. We have the greatest military in the world, by far. We're doing things that nobody thought possible, honestly. And we're going to continue to do that. It’s just the beginning.

You know what happened on the West Side Highway. That young wise guy drove over that...a lot of people. A lot of people died. We shouldn't let that happen. We have to be very, very strong. We're looking at bringing in more people, really, to help. Very powerful people. And in some cases, it’s easier to bring in people who are very good at doing the job, that really know what they're doing.

Key among these efforts are breaking chains of transmission between people. These measures have been extremely effective at reducing the spread of the virus. A couple of weeks ago, we had the largest single-day reduction in deaths ever recorded. And we're doing that now, and we're doing things we never thought would be possible. We're building hospitals in record time. We're doing a great job.

The United States has the best military by far, anywhere in the world. We have tremendous power, tremendous power. And we have the technology, and we have the equipment. We can do things that nobody else can do. We're building the greatest military the world has ever seen, ever. It's the greatest, and we've rebuilt our military. We have all new equipment. And beyond the military, we're also working on other things, including very important equipment.

And I think the word "vocational" is a much better word than, in many cases, "job training." We're doing tremendous job training, and we're doing tremendous things, but it's also vocational. We're doing vocational, and it's all very important. And the key is we're going to be giving these state governors whatever they need. They're going to call us up, and we'll take care of it. And we're ready.

If we are successful in this effort, then we can start the border project of a wall, and it will be completed very, very quickly. And we’ve started with that. We have the wall, and we’re building the wall. It’s going to be a great wall. And frankly, it’s already working better than anybody ever thought possible. Mexico, as you know, is paying for the wall, indirectly. They will, ultimately.

Throughout our history, the American people have always been the true source of American greatness. And as we've confronted the global pandemic, we've once again seen the grit, the courage, and the resolve of the American people. It's been amazing, frankly. We're delivering unprecedented levels of support, with billions and billions of dollars. We're delivering very, very rapidly, and we’re doing a job that nobody even thought was possible. Let's get that straight.

If we weren't here for the states, you would have had a problem in this country. And if we weren't there, and if we weren't working with them, they would have had a problem. You just have to look, just look at the job we've done. It's incredible. We are going to go out and we are going to help, and we are helping.

We're also taking action to prevent addiction by addressing the problem of overprescribing. And our strategy to stop the flow of illicit synthetic opioids, like fentanyl, is working. We have seized record amounts of these dangerous drugs. We're also making sure that all of our providers of care are giving the right care and they are getting a much better understanding of what's going on within the country.

The UK and the U. S., as you probably have been seeing and hearing, we're going to be working very closely together on this, which is really good. They want to do this, so it's great for us. We're making an agreement with the UK, and we're also making an agreement with other countries. We're talking to many countries. We're finding that--we're finding that they want to deal with us. We're seeing that.

But that's different than test, because with a test you can always say, "Oh, we--we need more,” right? No, I think we've done incredibly well with--obviously, with ventilators. We're--we also have 500 million masks that are very shortly going to be here. A lot of masks. We've made millions and millions of masks. They're pouring in. We have ordered millions of masks that have arrived and have been distributed very rapidly.

And after that person -- namely, me -- won, and convincingly won at 306 to 223 if you can believe it, we're going to be doing even better next time. We're going to be doing even better, because we know what we're doing. We're very proud of what we've done, and it's been really something. Now we have the greatest economy in the history of our country. We're very proud of it.

For decades, China has taken advantage of the United States. Now we have changed that, and it's a great thing. We have a lot of money pouring into our Treasury, but like never before, and we'll use it wisely, very wisely. We are the envy of the world, and we will continue to be because we are very smart people. We're doing things nobody thought possible.
